_comment: Squatch gear on the walls and on the furniture. Drop images into assets/art/ and point a slot at one. Slots without a file get a procedurally drawn placeholder poster. See README.md in this folder for the slot list.

art.title: The shield
art.caption: First thing you see every morning, whether you want to or not.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2022
art.caption: The first one. Nobody knew what they were doing and it did not matter.

art.title: Under the lights
art.caption: IEM Dallas 2024. Six of you and about forty thousand watts.

art.title: The whole roster
art.caption: Somebody had to stand at the back. It is always the same somebody.

art.title: Silver Sasquatches
art.caption: Hung at eye level, so it is the last thing you see before you queue.

art.title: Dallas, after hours
art.caption: Matching tees, string lights, and nobody checking the time.

art.title: Hawaiian shirt night
art.caption: There was a reason for this. It has not survived.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2023
art.caption: MEGGY. BOOSHI. LOU. RIP. SHUBES. Names on the wall, where they belong.

art.title: Met the pros
art.caption: Dippin' Dots and a photo you have shown far too many people.

art.title: Team banner
art.caption: Hung off a dowel, because a frame that wide costs more than the PC.

art.title: The crest
art.caption: EST. 2021. Mounted above the shelf like a coat of arms, which it is.

art.title: The chain
art.caption: Framed, on the sideboard. No further comment offered.

art.title: Golf, allegedly
art.caption: Two hot dogs, one cart, zero holes played.

art.title: Fridge magnet
art.caption: Been on that door longer than you have lived here.
